people.name: Jonah
people.line: Prophet swallowed by fish, preached to Nineveh

translations.web: God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He said, “I am right to be angry, even to death.”
translations.bsb: Then God asked Jonah, “Have you any right to be angry about the plant?” “I do,” he replied. “I am angry enough to die!”
translations.kjv: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.
translations.asv: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.
